verdict.rationale: Shopify's Global Catalog MCP server plus UCP profiles provide a discoverable, spec-conformant index that AI agents can query across the Shopify ecosystem (catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp), with machine-usable filters, pagination, and identity via agent profiles, and Storefront Catalog gives per-merchant discovery via a live introspectable schema. The UCP protocol itself is positioned as an industry-wide discovery/payment standard co-developed with major platforms. missing for 10: no independent third-party verification of a public directory of ALL payable services (llms.txt and openapi.json probes 404), and no evidence of a centralized cross-vendor discovery index beyond Shopify's own catalog/profile mechanism.
